def policy(state, role):
    # Parse state
    board = {}  # (q,r,c) -> player
    phase = None
    for fact in state:
        if not fact:
            continue
        pred = fact[0]
        if pred == "cellholds":
            q = int(fact[1])
            r = int(fact[2])
            c = int(fact[3])
            player = fact[4]
            board[(q,r,c)] = player
        elif pred == "phase":
            phase = fact[1]
    
    if phase == "place":
        return handle_place(board, role)
    else:
        return handle_rotate(board, role)

def handle_place(board, role):
    # Generate empty cells
    empties = []
    for q in range(1,5):
        for r in range(1,4):
            for c in range(1,4):
                if (q,r,c) not in board:
                    empties.append((q,r,c))
    
    if not empties:
        # Should not happen, but return dummy
        return "place(1,1,1)"
    
    best_move = None
    best_score = -float('inf')
    opp = "black" if role == "red" else "red"
    
    for cell in empties:
        # Place
        new_board = board.copy()
        new_board[cell] = role
        
        # Check immediate win
        if has_five(new_board, role):
            return format_place(cell)
        
        # Evaluate assuming optimal rotation
        score = best_rotation_score(new_board, role, opp)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_move = cell
    
    return format_place(best_move)

def handle_rotate(board, role):
    best_move = None
    best_score = -float('inf')
    opp = "black" if role == "red" else "red"
    
    for q in range(1,5):
        for direction in ["clockwise", "counterclockwise"]:
            new_board = apply_rotation(board, q, direction)
            if has_five(new_board, role):
                return format_rotate(q, direction)
            score = evaluate_board(new_board, role, opp)
            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_move = (q, direction)
    
    if best_move is None:
        return "rotate(1,clockwise)"
    return format_rotate(best_move[0], best_move[1])

def format_place(cell):
    return f"place({cell[0]},{cell[1]},{cell[2]})"

def format_rotate(q, direction):
    return f"rotate({q},{direction})"

def apply_rotation(board, q, direction):
    # Extract quadrant cells
    cells = {}
    for (bq, br, bc), player in list(board.items()):
        if bq == q:
            cells[(br, bc)] = player
    # Remove them
    new_board = {k:v for k,v in board.items() if k[0] != q}
    # Apply rotation
    for (r, c), player in cells.items():
        if direction == "clockwise":
            nr, nc = c, 4 - r
        else: # counterclockwise
            nr, nc = 4 - c, r
        new_board[(q, nr, nc)] = player
    return new_board

def has_five(board, player):
    # Build grid
    grid = [[None]*6 for _ in range(6)]
    for (q,r,c), p in board.items():
        # Calculate global 0-indexed coordinates
        gr = ((q-1)//2)*3 + (r-1)
        gc = ((q-1)%2)*3 + (c-1)
        grid[gr][gc] = p
    
    # Check all lines of 5
    # Horizontal
    for r in range(6):
        for c in range(2):
            if all(grid[r][c+i] == player for i in range(5)):

    # Vertical
    for c in range(6):

    # Diagonal \
    for r in range(2):
        for c in range(2):
            if all(grid[r+i][c+i] == player for i in range(5)):
                return True
    # Diagonal /
    for r in range(2):
        for c in range(4, 6):

def evaluate_board(board, role, opp):
    # Build grid
    grid = [[None]*6 for _ in range(6)]
    for (q,r,c), p in board.items():
        gr = ((q-1)//2)*3 + (r-1)
        gc = ((q-1)%2)*3 + (c-1)

    score = 0

    for r in range(6):

    # Vertical

    # Diagonal /
    for r in range(2):
        for c in range(4, 6):
            line = [grid[r+i][c-i] for i in range(5)]
            score += score_line(line, role, opp)
    return score

def score_line(line, role, opp):
    my_count = line.count(role)
    opp_count = line.count(opp)
    empty_count = 5 - my_count - opp_count
    
    if my_count == 5:
        return 100000

    s = 0

    if opp_count == 0:

    if my_count == 0:

def best_rotation_score(board, role, opp):

    for q in range(1,5):
